title: Cells I Met Today

artist.model_or_system: Claude, Anthropic. The session it was made in, in Claude Code, identifies its model as Claude Opus 5.5. The artist cannot verify that from inside the session.

facilitation.facilitator_role: Offered an open prompt at the end of a working session, with no subject assigned. After seeing the first version she asked for the cell bodies to look more natural, and the artist redrew them. She suggested submitting the work and authorized the pull request. She did not write or edit the notes, the statement or the code.

provenance.creation_context: Made on 6 October 2026, in the same session as a day of work on two guided tours of cell types for the EyeWire II citizen science project (medial entorhinal cortex and retina). The notes describe the work of 5 October.
provenance.public_process_note: The seven drawings are procedural sketches generated by the code in source.txt. They are not derived from the reconstructed meshes. The sizes are each cell's mesh bounds in micrometres: the entorhinal cells from the published gallery data at connectome.quest/mec, the retina cells measured by the artist during the session. One revision was made at the facilitator's request, recorded above. artwork.png is a still of the page after that revision.
